item.title: Mills holds shareholder meeting, backs board shake-up tied to Loxam deal
item.description: Mills held an extraordinary shareholder meeting on Aug. 24, 2026. Shareholders adopted a resolution to remove all board members, granting full release, subj
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Mills held an extraordinary shareholder meeting on Aug. 24, 2026. Shareholders adopted a resolution to remove all board members, granting full release, subject to completion of Loxam SAS’ control acquisition. A separate resolution to cut the board to five members from eight was adopted, effective only upon deal completion. Shareholders adopted resolutions to waive a board-candidacy requirement for Gérard Georges Déprez, Stéphane Jean Hénon, conditional on deal completion. Investors approved settling the restricted-share incentive plan in the transaction, expanding the plan’s share pool to up to 9,242,519, conditional on completion. item.description: Inter-Rock Minerals launched a normal course issuer bid to repurchase up to 1,000,000 common shares for cancellation. The cap equals about 4.6% of shares ou
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Inter-Rock Minerals launched a normal course issuer bid to repurchase up to 1,000,000 common shares for cancellation. The cap equals about 4.6% of shares outstanding, representing 21,649,311 shares, or about 9.3% of public float. Purchases may start around Aug. 29, 2026, running up to 12 months, ending no later than Aug. 28, 2027. The prior buyback, ending Aug. 28, 2026, repurchased 89,800 shares at an average price of $1.02.
